errors.statement: An international plan raises the predicted chance that a customer leaves more than anything else: for a typical customer, from about 2% to about 24%.
errors.check: probe --sweep calls=0,4,5,6 --no-parts: 2.3%, 13.7%, 49.4%, 85.7% (6 calls is inside the 1st-99th percentile); joint probe no plan, 271 min / $46.07: 50.0%; subgroup no plan, 260-280 min (n=130): mean predicted 54.6%, observed 56.2%. Service calls and heavy day use (both on support) move the typical customer far more than the plan's 2% -> 24%, so 'more than anything else' is broken by real counterexamples. The 2% -> 24% figure itself reproduces (C001). Within ann_87 alone ('matters most', blocks[1], C064) the ranking is fine and is not part of this error.
